confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable for Taiwan's coastal resort pricing. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak summer season in Kenting, and rates vary widely by weekday, property, and whether service and business taxes are included. The FX observation is the RBA value for 2026-10-15, the latest one I could corroborate; I did not verify a 2026-10-16 figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Taiwan's southern coastal resort towns and mid-sized Taiwanese tourist destinations such as Hualien and Taitung. Kenting's July peak demand is assumed to push accommodation above typical Taiwanese rates, and food and drink prices are assumed to sit slightly above non-resort Taiwanese cities.
